risks.title: Supply constraints on Blackwell Ultra
risks.quote: Shipments of Data Center Hopper products to China during the quarter were less than 1% of Data Center revenue.
risks.explanation: The quote indicates limited supply to China, a key market, which could constrain revenue growth and is quantified by the low percentage of revenue affected.

risks.title: Rising compute infrastructure costs
risks.quote: These increases were driven by higher compute infrastructure and compensation and benefits costs.
risks.explanation: The quote points to cost pressures affecting operating expenses, though no specific financial impact is stated.

risks.title: Slower consumer PC demand
risks.quote: slower consumer PC sales that were tempered by elevated memory and systems prices.
risks.explanation: The quote highlights weaker demand in consumer PC markets, which could reduce Edge Computing revenue, but no specific impact is quantified.
